purpose: Genre-local reference expansion pilot for mix, instrumentation, technique, articulation, and pattern review.
sourceRule: Each style owns its evidence. A reference can inform multiple styles only when the performance itself demonstrates each style; neighboring genres are not substitutes.

storageGate.note: User approved a bounded Flamenco-only storage exception, preserving about 5 GiB free. Continue one style at a time, use the existing Demucs environment, keep peak temporary audio within 1 GiB, retained reference/review audio within 500 MiB, and recheck free space before each style.
storageGate.forecastNewMp3sAtObservedMean: about 303 MiB for 55 added files, based on 17 existing Flamenco MP3s averaging 5.51 MiB each; actual duration/encoding may change this.
storageGate.forecastAtFivePerStyle: about 402 MiB for 73 added files at the same observed mean.

references.title: Soleá (Fiesta de la Bulería 1991)
references.youtubeTitle: LA FERNANDA NO SE PODIA AGUANTAR ESCUCHARLA
references.uploader: Embedded on Los Caminos del Cante; upload channel to confirm in source page
references.performance: Fernanda de Utrera and Moraíto at the 24th Fiesta de la Bulería in Jerez, 1991. The source commentary describes a complete soleá sequence with palmas and guitar; use the exact sequence to map variants and ensemble timing.
references.file: samples/Fernanda de Utrera - Soleá (Fiesta de la Bulería 1991).mp3
references.sourceVerification: YouTube title and 8:39 duration resolved in MediaHuman; local MP3 decodes with ffprobe. Los Caminos del Cante identifies the event, performers and soleá variants. Musical listening/timecode map pending.

references.title: Soleares de Joaquín el de la Paula y El Mellizo (La Soleá 1997)
references.youtubeTitle: Manuel Agujetas - Soleares de Joaquín el de la Paula y El Mellizo
references.performance: Manuel Agujetas with Curro de Jerez, recorded at La Soleá in October 1997. The source names two soleá lineages; verify passage boundaries during listening.
references.file: samples/Manuel Agujetas - Soleares de Joaquín el de la Paula y El Mellizo (La Soleá 1997).mp3
references.sourceVerification: MediaHuman resolved the title and 5:12 duration; local MP3 decodes with ffprobe. The source description credits Curro de Jerez and the October 1997 La Soleá recording. Musical listening/timecode map pending.

references.title: Soleá Niño Ricardo - Solo De Guitarra
references.youtubeTitle: Soleá Niño Ricardo - Solo De Guitarra
references.uploader: Paco de Lucía Official Artist Channel; audio distributed by BMG Rights Management (Spain)
references.performance: Solo flamenco guitar recording, credited to Paco de Lucía; 2024 YouTube release. Use for guitar technique, register, note decay and melodic development, not for ensemble balance.
